_declared_values.openingVariant: 'overlay' -- BrandOpening over the hook's settle, as on EP74-EP77 and EP80. The voice does not stop.
_declared_values.captionLeadSeconds: 0.0 -- the same value EP74, EP75, EP77 and EP80 ship. The on-disk 08_edit/captions.final.v001.srt is NOT what the render burns: step [4/7] of _finish_episode.sh regenerates the srt from the narration index and step [4b] polish_captions_srt.py shifts it to THIS number as a destination, not an increment. Changing the lead is a one-line change here, not an edit to the srt.

Total 1604.078 s = 26.7 min, inside episode_spec runtime_seconds [1740, 1920] once the brand opening, hook padding and ending bookend are added by the finisher.
_declared_values.figures_by_section: Authored 2026-08-27 from 03_script/script.en.v001.md and EP79_alaska261_FACTS_LEDGER.v001.md. Counts are 16/14/17/17 across ACT_1..ACT_4, inside episode_spec's figure_beats_per_act [13, 17]; HOOK 2 and ENDING 3, 69 cards in total. ACT_2 carries 14 rather than 17 because its window is the shortest at 174.7 s -- 17 cards there would be one every 10 s at a 6 s hold. EVERY number on a card is a number the narration speaks: 16, 32, 88, 10, 70, 5, 35000, 14, 3, 90, 22, 190000, 600, 700, 500, 1000, 1200, 1600, 2550, 400, 5780, 40, 5000, 6400, 9550, 1, 11, 18, 214, 13, 5, 75 all appear in 03_script/script.en.v001.md, and every stat `value` is numeric with the unit in `label` or `suffix`, so no card can render NaN. No `stat` carries a `group` key -- FigureBeats types `group` on `numberticker` only.
_declared_values.no_OP_section: episode_spec's section_vocabulary lists OP, but narration_index has no OP chunks -- the brand opening is an overlay on the HOOK, not a spoken section. A card there would have no window to live in.
_declared_values.disclosure_cards: build_case_film_generic merges the AI-disclosure lowerthird onto the FIRST and LAST figure after sorting, overwriting whatever payload is there. So the first HOOK card and the last ENDING card are authored AS that lowerthird; nothing written is destroyed by the merge. This is why ENDING carries three cards and not two.
_declared_values.quarantine: Nothing on screen accuses the mechanic who performed the September 1997 check (episode_spec forbidden_claims). His card is his own words and the card beside it is the tool his employer gave him. No card states a number for that check -- none exists (AK-309, AK-402). No card says Alaska Airlines was prosecuted: the DECEMBER 2001 card states that no charges would be filed, which is what the record says (AK-901). The 0.043, 0.048 and 0.075 inch readings appear only on ACT_4 cards labelled as the bench records of assemblies from other carriers (AK-702, AK-704), never as this aeroplane's. No card names a motive for the FAA approvals. No card blames the crew: their three quote cards are transcript, and the 14-degree card reports the stabilizer, not a pilot action. forbidden_subjects bans the accident itself, so no card depicts or names the impact, the wreckage or the recovery; the ENDING returns to the needle.
